method: Compare git index blob IDs with git hash-object --no-filters of every staged regular file, and exact symlink target bytes.
attributes: Task-local .gitattributes sets -text for all evidence and -diff/-merge only for opaque content-addressed objects.
reason: Initial staging warned that CRLF would normalize in one resource CSV and several raw source archive objects; re-staged under exact-byte attributes before commit.
whitespace: Original raw evidence whitespace is intentionally preserved. Authored diff has one harmless final blank line in the already-hash-bound sampling helper; retained to preserve completed evidence.
